query:
SELECT commended_user_id AS "user_id!: SbUserId", 'commend' AS "kind!"
                FROM game_commends
                WHERE game_id = $1 AND commender_id = $2
                UNION ALL
                SELECT reported_user_id AS "user_id!: SbUserId", 'report' AS "kind!"
                FROM game_reports
                WHERE game_id = $1 AND reporter_id = $2
